title: The Adjustment of Stock Prices to New Information
one_line: The first event study: around 940 stock splits (1926-1960), abnormal returns occur before the split and prices adjust quickly at the announcement, mostly reflecting expected dividend increases — evidence that prices absorb news rapidly.

findings.statement: Large positive abnormal returns before splits; adjustment by the split month.
Response depends on subsequent dividend changes.
